items.title: Baker Tilly notifies clients of data breach at third-party provider
items.summary: The Baker Tilly Advisory Group is notifying clients that a data breach has compromised certain personal information about them and their dependents. [...]

items.title: Active ScreenConnect attacks breach MSPs, impact dozens of organizations
items.summary: ConnectWise is investigating an active malware campaign targeting managed service providers (MSPs) that uses compromised ScreenConnect environments to deploy rogue remote-access clients to customer devices. [...]

items.title: eMudhra revokes 8 more CA certificates after private key mishap
items.summary: Certificate authority eMudhra has revoked eight additional intermediate CA certificates after an investigation into its recent certificate security incident found improper handling of private keys during the certificate-generation process. [...]

items.title: Notion says Fireworks breach exposed customer AI chat transcripts
items.summary: Notion, the digital workspace platform, disclosed that a security breach at its AI infrastructure provider, Fireworks AI, exposed Notion AI chat transcripts in a small number of workspaces. [...]

items.title: Maersk confirms data breach as WhiteArmor ransomware demands $5 million
items.summary: Maersk announced that a threat actor gained unauthorized access to a local legacy system inherited through an earlier acquisition and extracted data from it. [...]

items.title: Hackers use AntiFox AI agents in AWS credential-theft attacks
items.summary: Attackers are using Alibaba Cloud to host self-managed instances of AntiFox, an open-source agentic penetration testing platform, to target web services and AWS environments. [...]

items.title: eBPF Rootkits: Why Underground Actors Are Taking Notice
items.summary: Linux eBPF rootkits can hide malicious activity and evade traditional detection methods without loading kernel modules. Flare reveals how these techniques are spreading through underground forums, where threat actors are sharing rootkit source code, tutorials, and exploits targeting Linux systems. [...]

items.title: N-able releases security hotfixes for zero-day vulnerabilities
items.summary: N-able released hotfixes to address zero-day bugs affecting its N-central remote monitoring and management (RMM) platform, which were publicly disclosed over the weekend and forced it to take vulnerable hosted environments offline. [...]

items.title: Microsoft fixes audio issues caused by September security updates
items.summary: Microsoft says the November 2026 cumulative updates resolve USB audio issues plaguing Windows users who have installed security updates released since September. [...]

items.title: CISA flags Cisco BroadWorks flaw as actively exploited in attacks

items.title: Microsoft fixes Exchange sign-ins broken by Windows Server updates

items.title: Railway breach leads to $740,000 in fraudulent AI charges

items.title: Japanese furniture giant Nitori says hackers stole 37.6M customer records
items.summary: Nitori, a major Japanese furniture and home accessories retailer, discovered that an attacker accessed a system on its network and may have stolen 37.62 million customer records. [...]

items.title: Microsoft releases Windows 10 KB5131096 extended security update
